responsibility: Handwritten option-definition file for the NVPTX target. It declares the backend’s user-visible and internal -m options, including ABI selection remnants, soft-stack and uniform-SIMT controls, OpenMP offloading mode, PTX ISA architecture and PTX-version selectors, register initialization policy, and architecture alias mappings, thereby driving GCC’s option parser and the target flags consumed by nvptx.cc and related headers.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem nvptx files, this is the handwritten .opt file that declares NVPTX-specific -m options, aliases, and PTX version/architecture selectors for GCC's option machinery; unlike nvptx.cc it does not implement backend behavior, unlike nvptx.h it does not define target macros/types, and unlike nvptx.md it does not describe RTL instruction patterns.
